content: Amǝ Isǝrayila peri aban Ba'al a Piyor
Mana amǝ Isǝrayila na a bando a Shitim ngga, aburana mala amǝ Isǝrayila kùtí a nongginǝ amamǝna mala amǝ'Mowap.
Pǝlǝa amamǝna mǝnia tunǝ aburana man ɓǝà kyane aban apa'girnkila mala aɓakuli malea. Pǝlǝa amǝnia yì aburana ka, à lì girlina ɗārǝâ, sǝ à peri aban aɓakuli mala amǝ'Mowap.
Anggo, sǝ amǝ Isǝrayila kùtí a peri aban Ba'al Piyor, sǝ bum Yahweh pi arǝia kǝ̀rkǝ́r.

Sǝ Yahweh ne Musa ama, <<Twal aɓwana-mǝgule mala mǝnia yì aɓwana mǝnana à pàk gìr man ngga, sǝ wu wal-luia nǝ gyarban a pwari, aɓadǝmbam Yahweh, ace mǝnana nggea bumlulla mem Yahweh ka ɓǝ̀ sulǝî múr Isǝrayila.>>
Pǝlǝa Musa banggi amǝ'ɓashi mala amǝ Isǝrayila ama, <<Koyan atà wun ngga, ɓǝ̀ wal-lú aɓwana male mana à oasǝ múrià aɓa peri aban Ba'al Piyor ka.>>
Sǝ mwashat atà amǝ Isǝrayila yinǝ ɓè ɓwama Midiyan
aban aɓwana male, a mǝsǝ Musa ngguont, sǝ a mǝsǝ amǝ Isǝrayila puppup, yi mana à nda ban ɓua a bankutio aɓa Tara Ban-peri ka.
Lang Finehas muna-ɓwabura mala Eleaza, muna-ɓwabura mala Haruna, pǝris, sǝni ka, lo nying ɓwabundǝa, kya twal nzo a bui,
pǝlǝa o atà ɓwa Isǝrayila mǝno aɓa gumli male. Kara zuɓia yià kǝm, yì ɓwabure, ɓwa Isǝrayila andǝ ɓwame, kya sa a bum ɓwame. Kara kwánó-ɓikea mana nda amur amǝ Isǝrayila ka came.
Sǝama aɓwana mana à wǔ aɓa kwánó-ɓikea mǝnia ka à nda á-lumi-ɓari-nong-ine (24,000).
Ɓabumpina mala Finehas
Sǝ Yahweh ne Musa ama,

<<Finehas muna-ɓwabura mala Eleaza, muna-ɓwabura mala Haruna, pǝris ka, pwasǝlǝna nggea bumlulla mem arǝ amǝ Isǝrayila, acemǝnana yì ka, ndanǝ ulang bumpina mem aɓalǝi. Acemani ka, Ən twalta amǝ Isǝrayila aɓa bumpina mem ɗàng.
Acemani ka, ne wi ama, <Mǝ ndaban kùrcau nǝi mala dorǝpwala mem.
Sǝ yì andǝ amǝ'ke atè ka, ǝn kurnacau mala lidǝmba malea aɓa dobuno-pǝris, acemǝnana pàk bumpina ace Ɓakuli male, sǝ shawuɗi amǝ Isǝrayila.> >>
Lullǝ ɓwa Isǝrayila mana à wal-lui andǝ ɓwama Midiyan ngga, nda Zǝmri, muna-ɓwabura mala Salu, ɓwamǝgule a ɓala-kàu a tàu mala Shimiyon.
Sǝ lullǝ ɓwama Midiyan mana à wal-lui ka nda Kosbi muna-ɓwama mala Zur, ɓwamǝgule amur ɓala-kau mala ɓè tau mala amǝ Midiyan.
Pǝlǝa Yahweh nacau nǝ Musa ama,
<<Kyan nǝ munǝo arǝ amǝ'Midiyan, kǝla aɓiwun-amǝbura, wu walia.

Acemǝnana à pàngnǝ wun kǝla aɓia-mǝbura nǝ swarkiban mǝnana à swarki wun a cau mala Piyor, sǝ a cau mala Kosbi, nsarile ɓwamǝgule mala amǝ Midiyan, mǝ'eambia muna-ɓwama mana à wal-lui a pwari mala kwánó-ɓikea atàcau mala Piyor ka.>>

footnotes.text: Midiyan: À pàktúró nǝi akani kǝla lullǝu mana kpapi akûn mala aɓwapǝndǝa ɗàngɗáng mǝnana à do a takuli mala Nggeasala Jodan ngga. Aɓea atà aɓwapǝndǝa man ngga yakǝla ɓwa Mowap nda murǝm amúrià; sǝni a Tite 36:35; Ɓal 31:8; Jes 13:21.
